Milestone: Secure partner data access and run the two falsification tests
Detail: The earliest substantive research work, and the gate on the field anchor. EXP-25 needs historical management-information-system data from one or more originators across regions to estimate default correlation; EXP-22 needs an originator willing to run two origination protocols side by side with costing. Neither needs a field pilot, a grant or ethics approval on the scale a trial does - which is the point of running them first. The partner ask here is materially smaller than a pilot proposal: five years of anonymised portfolio data is a request an MFI network can answer in a week, where hosting a multi-year randomised trial takes a year. Lead outreach (M-03, M-04) with this ask. If EXP-25 finds default is covariate rather than idiosyncratic, or EXP-22 finds capture costs exceed the value they unlock, the pooling thesis needs restructuring before any field money is spent - see the falsification table in docs/research/research-framework.md. ASK SHARPENED 2026-08-22 by the EXP-25 respec. The request is no longer 'share your portfolio data'. It is: pseudonymised loan-level records covering a window that CONTAINS A SHOCK, from TWO lenders in the same market. Two lenders per market is a design minimum, not a preference - with one lender the institutional channel is unidentified and a near-zero market correlation would be an artefact of the design rather than a finding. The ask also now carries an offer: every participating lender gets its own variance decomposition back, which is a number none of them currently has about their own book. And it is explicitly pseudonymised, with no personal identifiers requested, which lowers the barrier to a yes. Screen any offered dataset for a shock in the window BEFORE accepting it - a quiet panel produces a falsely reassuring near-zero covariate component, which is the most dangerous failure mode here because it looks like success. OUTREACH SEQUENCING, from the EXP-22 spec: approach a new originator with EXP-22 FIRST, not EXP-25. EXP-22 asks only for permission to vary a process and observe it - no historical data disclosure - and it gives the originator something immediately usable: a costed answer to what it would take for their book to be investable, a validated field list, and a time-and-motion baseline of their own origination that most originators do not have. That is a far easier first yes, and the relationship it builds is what makes EXP-25's loan-level data request plausible later. Also screen every candidate for CLUSTER COUNT before anything else - 10 to 40 branches is typical and is the binding constraint on EXP-22's design. The experimental designs this milestone delivers are a research partner's project on their grant, not a solo business's cost.
